# AI video QA: measure a render for glitches, banding, typos and drift

**A finished video, image or track becomes a list of timed, measured defects with evidence frames, and takes ranked by defects.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_1283ff3c284b.webp" alt="Media-judge output for a vertical product reel: attention heat maps over frames beside a facts table where checks are marked clear, flagged or info." width="480"></p>

Judge a finished AI-made video, image or track by measuring it, then rank takes on the defects found. One command reads every frame and writes facts with timestamps and evidence: broken frames, banding after a simulated X or YouTube upload, numbers that jiggle, spelling, too much on screen, nothing leading the eye, motion with no cause, pinned graphics, sliding labels, a face, outfit or light that changed, sound after the cut, loudness, voice against the script, and distance to references against the template. A fresh agent settles only what eyes can settle. No score out of 10. Use when someone says "review this video", "check my render", "self-review", "QA", "judge", "critique", "score these takes", "pick the best take", "does it match the reference", "it looks like a template", "is it ready to post", "reverse engineer this reel", or after any agent finishes a film, short drama, reel or ad. Not for making or repairing media (varg-ai, varg-video-editing) or ad law (ai-ad-compliance-check).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill media-judge                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills media-judge --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Review film.mp4 before I post it to X: broken frames, typos, upload banding and loudness"
- "Rank the four takes in ./takes by defects; it's the same person in every shot"
- "Check my 9:16 reel against ref.mp4 and tell me whether it still looks like the template"
